For information only — not financial advice. Match dollars may vest over time.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your salary.
  2. Enter the % of salary you contribute.
  3. Enter the employer match rate % and the % of salary the match applies to.
  4. Read the free employer money, your contribution, and the combined total.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does '50% match on the first 6%' mean?

Enter 50 as the match rate and 6 as the cap. If you contribute at least 6%, the employer adds 3% of your salary.

Should I contribute beyond the cap?

Contributions beyond the cap earn no extra match in this formula, but they still grow your own savings. This tool does not give advice.

Is the match vested immediately?

Often not. Many employers vest the match over a few years; leaving early can forfeit unvested match dollars.
